name: Kshitiz Upadhyay
research_summary: Upadhyay studies how soft materials such as biological tissues and polymers deform, heat up, and suffer damage under demanding conditions. He combines advanced experiments and physics-informed machine learning for applications including brain injury, protective systems, and discovering new materials.
